restaurants.name: JinJu Patisserie
restaurants.summary: The acclaimed patisserie reopened in a new North Williams home (soft opening Oct. 21); Karen Brooks predicts its salt breads are destined for Portland cult status.

restaurants.name: Hua Hin PDX
restaurants.summary: Chef-owner Ize Piyanut's sprawling, minimalist Thai restaurant named for her coastal hometown; The Infatuation singles out the steamed barramundi with lime and chile and the grilled pork jowl with jaew.

reviews.verdict: Added to the Portland Hit List (updated Oct. 13)

restaurants.name: Strange-Bird
restaurants.summary: A former food cart now in a SE Clinton space, doing wood-fired pizza and shareable plates; a new entry on The Infatuation's Hit List of new Portland restaurants.

reviews.verdict: Added to the Portland Hit List (updated Oct. 13)

restaurants.name: Mémoire Cà Phê
restaurants.summary: A low-key, counter-service Vietnamese American brunch spot on Alberta; the shrimp omelet is the dish to get.

reviews.verdict: Added to the Portland Hit List (updated Oct. 13)

restaurants.name: Sushi Fukami
restaurants.summary: Nimblefish chef Cody Auger's eight-seat hinoki counter serves a roughly 21-course omakase mixing Washington crab and Oregon petrale sole with Spanish tuna and Japanese uni.

restaurants.name: Marée
restaurants.summary: From Fantino's Garrett McAleese in the former Dame space, a fish-forward bistro inspired by San Sebastián that cooks peak-season Oregon ingredients simply.

reviews.verdict: Brings the Basque coast to NE Killingsworth

restaurants.name: Guay Tiew
restaurants.summary: Counter-service boat noodle shop from the Thai Peacock and Khao Moo Dang team; WW says any worry about blandness vanishes at the first bite, with the wheat noodles the top pick.

reviews.verdict: A tasty lesson in Thai noodle soup

restaurants.name: OK Chicken & Khao Soi
restaurants.summary: Earl Ninsom (Eem, Yaowarat) took over the original Pok Pok space; Portland Monthly calls it easily the buzziest local opening of the year, with a flamethrower-hot som tum Lao.

reviews.verdict: Easily the buzziest local opening of the year

restaurants.name: Bar Siete
restaurants.summary: Oswaldo Bibiano's seventh restaurant and first full bar, in the former Shaku Bar space; WW singled out the $7 small bites, the borrego tatemado and a fiery huevo en diablado.

reviews.verdict: First look: one of Portland's foundational Mexican chefs

restaurants.name: Oscar Food & Wine
restaurants.summary: A tiny natural-wine spot in the former Kashiwagi sushi space with a fish-heavy menu that WW found transportive despite sitting next to a Plaid Pantry.

restaurants.name: Dear Lola
restaurants.summary: Former Magna Kusina chef de cuisine Danté Fernandez cooks diaspora Filipino food, from regional specialties to dishes of his own, inside the cocktail bar Too Soon.

reviews.verdict: One of three must-try new AAPI-owned eateries

restaurants.name: Yui
restaurants.summary: Chef Chalunthorn "Yui" Schaeffer's Thai restaurant settled into a permanent SE Belmont home after years of pop-ups, and earned praise in Portland Monthly's roundup of new Thai spots.

reviews.verdict: Praised in a review of three new Thai restaurants

restaurants.name: Bangkok Belly
restaurants.summary: A small-menu Thai newcomer whose satay skewers Portland Monthly called the star of the show; the Mercury also named it a must-try.

reviews.verdict: One of three must-try new AAPI-owned eateries

restaurants.name: Lil' Barbecue
restaurants.summary: Portland outpost of a Michelin-starred Texas barbecue operation; Michael Russell's review (as reported by Hoodline) ranks the smoked beet ends with the chicken and pork ribs as the best things to eat. Go early, since meats sell out.

reviews.verdict: Beet ends are a surprisingly legit vegan option

restaurants.name: Bar Nouveau
restaurants.summary: Althea Grey Potter's former pop-up turned St. Johns bistro serves chicken liver mousse, gribiche deviled eggs and steak au poivre; WW calls it shockingly unpretentious for how chic it is. Reservations required.

reviews.verdict: A scrappy send-up to French cookbook cuisine
Shockingly unpretentious for how chic it is
